meta.name: architecture-patterns
meta.description: Implement proven backend architecture patterns including Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design. Use this skill when designing clean architecture for a new microservice, when refactoring a monolith to use bounded contexts, when implementing hexagonal or onion architecture patterns, or when debugging dependency cycles between application layers.

copy.tagline: 用成熟模式搭建后端架构,消除层间依赖纠缠
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正为后端代码的层与依赖关系头疼
copy.tagline_en: Design clean backend architecture and eliminate tangled dependencies.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are struggling with layered architecture and dependency cycles in your backend.

howto.what: 它会为后端服务或模块设计分层结构(实体、用例、适配器等),明确依赖只能向内的规则、接口定义和测试边界,并涵盖 Clean Architecture、六边形架构与 DDD。
howto.when: 当你要为新微服务设计架构、把单体按限界上下文重构、实现六边形或洋葱架构等场景时接管。

say.text: 帮我为新订单服务设计 Clean Architecture 的分层结构
say.note: 产出层级划分与依赖规则

say.text: 检查我的 use_cases 层有没有依赖到 adapters
say.note: 会指出违反依赖方向的导入

say.text: 用内存适配器给 CreateUserUseCase 写单元测试

howto.what_en: It designs a layered structure for a backend service or module — entities, use cases, adapters — with inward-only dependency rules, interface definitions and test boundaries, covering Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture and DDD.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you design architecture for a new microservice, refactor a monolith into bounded contexts, or implement hexagonal or onion architecture.

say_en.text: Design the Clean Architecture layers for a new order service
say_en.note: Returns layer split and dependency rules

say_en.text: Check whether my use_cases layer imports from adapters
say_en.note: Flags imports that break the dependency direction

say_en.text: Write a unit test for CreateUserUseCase using an in-memory adapter
say_en.note: Runs with no database or Docker
